description.value: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain with over 25 years in the industry, specializing in wood-fired pizzas with authentic charred crusts and Italian-sourced ingredients. This Burnaby location sits on Lougheed Highway on the second floor and is one of roughly 16 locations across the province. The chain offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a reasonable refuelling stop along a Lower Mainland route.
